reviews.author: Sunshine Richardson
reviews.text: Awesome service. They were able to order my tires for next day and get me in and out quickly without an appointment. Found the tires I wanted/needed and even found a deal (rebate) on them.

reviews.author: robert “bob” magolnick
reviews.text: Very pleasant and knowledgeable people and they don't try and sell you things you don't need..Rocky.was.awesome

reviews.author: Rick Mebane
reviews.text: Guy knew the stuff and handled my 1988 mustang old school with care and gave me a good deal. I will be doing business with them again.

reviews.author: Karsyn Grady
reviews.text: Took my Kia Forte GT-Line here yesterday and they were able to pull my car back within minutes! Always very nice and will always give you the best route to take with any problem you might have!

reviews.author: Jessica Clark
reviews.text: I can’t say enough great things about the crew here! If you’re having car problems I’d definitely recommend the guys here

reviews.author: Susan Vernon
reviews.text: This wasnt my first visit and as a business owner myself for 33 years I was most impressed with professionalism, concerned for your need, cordial and took their job very seriously. I first went last week to schedule a appointment for this week and dealt with Austin such a wonderful professional concerned gentleman and the guy over aligning my front end of my car, today I had the privilege of meeting Rocky and such a genuine gentleman that loves his job and customers. Everyone there appeared to enjoy their job and work environment. I would honestly give these guys 10 stars for their efficiency and knowledge and professionalism. This day in time it is very rare to find businesses so efficient and working together. This place needs to be commended for their integrity and work. I had just experienced an ordeal that cost me almost a 1,000 dollars right down the street from Beroth before I found out about Beroth. You guys have a wonderful name in the community. Remember to never lose that integrity it carried me through my whole career and goes beyond any advertisement that can be published the number one word of mouth will take care of your business to always be successful. Thank you kindly Austin, Rocky and the knowledgeable gentleman in the service dept and your knowledge to work on Mercedes Benz you are most greatly appreciated. GOD BLESS YOU AND THE BUSINESS GRATEFUL SUSAN GRIFFIN VERNON

reviews.author: Cindy Jessup Green
reviews.text: These guys are the absolute best. Rocky and Roger look after their customers. Twice this year they’ve fixed my car when the Chevy dealership fell short. Prices were really fair too. Also helped me find a new set of tires last year at a great price. Unlike some other places, Beroth treats lady customers right. No games - I trust them. I’ll always give them my business.

reviews.author: Gregory Bray
reviews.text: I’ve dealt with this store for many years, but I don’t know what has happened since the original owner passed away, but they are the most untrustworthy people in business in rockingham county. I would not recommend them to change the oil in my in my deep fryer. My daughter went there a few weeks ago because her hatchback is electrical and would not raise up on its own and they told her it would be between $40 and $60 to do a computer check to find out what was wrong. They actually charged her $85 and told her that there was an off switch inside the cabin of the car that was turned off . And I don’t think $85 was right. The other thing my daughter complained about was her heat and air-conditioning was not working properly so they told her that her antifreeze was low put 2 gallons of antifreeze in her car and said that was her problem. Well she drove away, and her air conditioner quit working again so we carried it to another mechanic and he said that her blower motor was malfunctioning and has to be replaced . I think they were praying on my daughter because she was a female and probably didn’t know better.

reviews.author: Buddy Lee Idol
reviews.text: I had a problem pumping gas. Joe said leave it with them and they would diagnose the problem. They kept my ride all day. When I got off work I went over to see if they found problem. They told me fuel filler pipe. I asked how much to repair, joe was vague, saying 300 to 400. I asked for a closer price. He said he would call....never did. I stopped by again asking when he could fix it and wanting to know how much. Once again I was told somebody would call, didn't happen. The following week I called and was told 400. So we agreed he would fix the following Tuesday. So early Thursday morning I took my ride up at 7:30 he said they would call when they were done it might take all day so I didn't check on it till 5:00 that afternoon. so I arrived after I got off of work ask Joe where my car was he said it was still in the shop I said is it fixed he said no I said why not he first said that we didn't get the party in although I scheduled this week out so he could get the party in and then I told him that I was angry because my car sit there all day long with nobody calling me and telling me that they couldn't do anything with it he then changed his story and said well they sent the wrong part this is not my problem that's the problem between him and the vendor. so he said he would call the next day when the part come in once again nobody called me at the end of the day I decided to take a different direction I took it to another shop that I'd been to before and it turns out that what they said was wrong wasn't even wrong it was not the fuel filler pipe it was a vent filter that cost half the price of what he was going to charge me to not even completely correct my car. I definitely do not recommend these guys at all.

reviews.author: Anthony Dalton
reviews.text: Was in and out in no time for an oil change. They're always always friendly and knowledgable. The price was amazing and beat out anywhere else that I've priced. The gentleman at the service desk is the best ever, so friendly. A little later after my service was done and I had left, he had called and left me a voicemail regarding a rebate I qualified for and let me know to expect it in the mail. Awesome followup. I've bought tires, inspections, tire rotation (usually free with the oil changes) and some major hub replacement work (for which I would not have gotten a better deal anywhere). I won't take my vehicle for any kind of service anywhere but Beroth's in Madison.

reviews.author: Iris Paraszewski
reviews.text: I actually enjoy going to the Shop. I trust the guys. I just know they wouldn’t suggest something if I didn’t need it. In the past my car would have problems and, I felt they were doing something to my car. Now I only go to the shop and, they actually know who I am. I have and will continue to send people there. You might have too wait but, it’s so worth it. I Thank them and, I Pray for them as well. Just go there and they will fix what’s wrong.

reviews.author: Bree Travis
reviews.text: I would like to start off by saying that I come to this establishment very often for all my car needs based on how I am treated and taken care of by Roger. He is knowledgeable, personable, kind, and always manages to put me at ease. The guys that work "behind the scenes" are speedy and efficient as well but I do not know them by name to commend them.

reviews.author: Maria Moore
reviews.text: I went Friday to get my car inspected. I paid for the service and my car failed because of my 2 front tires. I went and got new tires put on. I called before they closed and they told me to come on in Monday to get the inspection to pass. I go there and he tells me it won’t be until Wednesday. Mind you that I only have today off. So they pretty much got me for my money because I have to get it done today to pay for my sticker. Smh I won’t be going back there again.

reviews.author: Tammy Hopkins
reviews.text: Not satisfied at all!! Was told 3 hours to fix my issue.They did not have proper tools for job.....got my Vehicle back 3 days later to find out they fixed the wrong side!!! We were very clear on what needed to be done.When we brought it to there attention we were simply told ohhh!!!! Never again!!!!!

reviews.author: Brandon Willard
reviews.text: The third beroth tire location I've been to, and it was the same across the board, people had a good attitude and was helpful.

reviews.author: Woodenveins
reviews.text: I called a day in advance to make sure they had the tires I needed. I needed 4 tires for my camper and they had 8 in stock. Three people changed my tires and they checked my spare tire out also. They put my desired pressure in the tires and they balanced them and torqued the lugs. When they were finished they inspected my truck. I was in and out in slightly less than one hour. Everyone was very courteous.

reviews.author: Patricia Martin
reviews.text: Very rude and told us it would be about 20-30 minutes to get our van inspected and we sat for an hr & half. Then tell us there printer not working so we couldn't get a paper saying it passed but it would b in the computer. So we went to vavaline on meadow rd. No waiting and very nice people. Very quick service

reviews.author: Joyce Felts
reviews.text: I am a widow & love these guys especially Roger & Rocky! It means a lot that I can put 100 percent trust in them to give me honest advice as to what needs to be done for my vehicle. Don't know what I would do without them!

reviews.author: Susan Thompson
reviews.text: While I am having an issue right now I am going to rate Beroth with a solid 5 star! I have been going to this shop for a few years now and as a woman who worked for a small repair shop I do absolutely know what some people try to pull on women. I haven’t experienced that at all. I am disappointed that I have paid double for one sensor that I have purchased all 4 for but am happy with the resolution offered to me. I learned an expensive lesson but still am overall very satisfied with the service I have always received from the guys here!! I wish I had checked it out prior to okaying the work and that’s on me. As I said lesson learned!

reviews.author: Linda Berry
reviews.text: I have used Beroth Tire and Automotive in Madison for all my car and truck needs for over 20 years. They are honest, dependable, friendly and stand behind their repairs. I have never had a bad experience with their service.

reviews.author: Rusty Shackleford
reviews.text: Much like any other auto mechanics if you go in for anything they're going to attempt an upsell haha. I went in for an inspection, oil change, an a front end alignment / tire rotation and ended up with all that as well as a new set of tires and tie rods. That's just the way it is with mechanics, so that being said I will say that they did very good work and the rates for parts / labor were very reasonable. My old car tracks straight as an arrow now (very good alignment job) and my car was in and out in about 4 hours time. They were very friendly and courteous. Honestly if you're needing work done in the Madison, Mayodan area I can recommend them, just be aware you're going to end up getting more done than you planned on going in. All-n-all, four stars.

reviews.author: Paul and Katrina Ratchford
reviews.text: I always bring my car to Beroth! Roger knows me by name and the guys are always professional and helpful. They treat me like a person and never try to sell me something I don’t need just because I’m a woman. I gladly wait when they are busy, because I trust them. And if something is wrong... they ALWAYS make it right!! Thanks Beroth!

reviews.author: Wendy
reviews.text: Absolutely the best place ever! Outstanding work and very nice ppl. I won’t go anywhere else. I can’t say enough how happy I was with all my services.

reviews.author: Pam Goad
reviews.text: I went to get air put in my tire and come to find out, it was two sensor bad I didn’t have my Beroth credit card with me and he said he couldn’t look it up for me. That’s the only problem that really bothered me.

reviews.author: Dwayne Hutchens
reviews.text: They were great, got me in and out as fast as they could considering how busy they were on a Friday afternoon! New tires and oil change,Very friendly and helpful! Would recommend!

reviews.author: Colby Jernigan
reviews.text: I call on Friday, ordered two tires and am told to come get them put on Tuesday. I called that morning just to verify the tires had arrived, but they had no idea who I was or anything about my order. They said they could get the tires (for more than I was originally told) and instructed me what time to come in. When I arrived, I was informed the tires were “on the way”. They didn’t pull my car into the bay for an hour and a half. Just as bad as Beroth tire in Kernersville

reviews.author: Ricky Lacy
reviews.text: Got an heater core. Put in an was charged. 932. Dollars. My interior. Was left not put together. Along with my linkage. To my odometer. Being off car would not move. Went back. Numerous. Times. There. Dishonest take the money an run.

reviews.author: Paul Welch
reviews.text: Just got 4 new tires and the boy who put them on didn’t balance them. To take the easy way out he put bag weights in them. It was 15 minutes after leaving when we realize it and they had closed. When I ask to fix it they said we are closed. They said they were closed. I will not be going back nor do I recommend them. Also just found out he over inflated them by 40psi

reviews.author: Shane L
reviews.text: Great place that me and my family have always gone to for general servicing of our vehicles. If you head down to Beroth, make sure to talk to Roger, he's an awesome guy.

reviews.author: Jerry “Bone” Fargis
reviews.text: I'm going too start off by saying I wouldn't even checked this one star but only to leave my review. so my girlfriend took her car too this so called business because of a bad vibration so he suggested too leave it and they would look at it so she did we picked it up at 5 and charged her $800 and said he fix and replaced 9 different things but still didn't fix the vibration then she takes it too a local honest place in Eden she showed them all the work that this place said they did but only done 4 out of the 9 things that were supposed to be fix and that the labor was $75 n hour where they only get $50 too $55 and could have cut the overall price in half. with this being said she has one wheel that is bent and Beroth is a Tire Shop what a joke but never again for us and I would suggest a 2nd opinion.

reviews.author: Sirena
reviews.text: Called about a nail in my tire. Asked if I could bring my truck bye and they said to head that way. Got there 20mins later they got me in for the nail in the tire and did a oil change. Super nice people.

reviews.author: Medina Begic
reviews.text: i got here at 7:50, for a basic oil change and tire rotation. i did not leave until almost 9:45 and even then my tires were not rotated and i had to go back. they do not rotate tires when they say they do, i know this for a fact because i marked my tires.

reviews.author: Billy Hughes
reviews.text: Great people,and honest…and if your vehicle is gonna be there a while,they will give u something to drive….They treat there customers well!!!!

reviews.author: Kim Richardson
reviews.text: I went at a good time, wasn't there long at all. The guys were friendly and jokesters also. One of my best experiences so far.

reviews.author: Kelly Sroka
reviews.text: I have been going to Beroth for a while now. They have always been so courteous and accommodating. I trust them to do an great job and give fantastic service.

reviews.author: Billy Smith
reviews.text: Sent my mom there to get her oil changed. She gets home and you can't see the truck for smoke. I checked the oil, about a quart too much. They send a rollback to pick it up and fix it, then charge her the towing bill. Not recommended at all

reviews.author: Jason Rakestraw
reviews.text: My wife went there to get her vehicle inspected for convienince. They failed her tires. This is a 2016 vehicle with 18000 miles. I knew there was tread left so I took it to get it inspected elsewhere. He measured the tread and said there was 10000 miles left. The guy at Beroth was just trying to sell my wife some tires by failing her inspection. I wonder how many times they pull that trick off a day.

reviews.author: Jeff Crosby
reviews.text: Awesome people with quality auto service at fair prices to boot. I never hesitate to choose them on the auto work that's not worth my time to do myself. Thanks BEROTH!!!

reviews.author: Jennifer Frame
reviews.text: Travelling for the holidays and blew a tire. They went ABOVE and BEYOND to help us get our car back on the road!

reviews.author: Ken Walker
reviews.text: Buyer beware of this place! Very poor customer service. I had been a loyal customer of Beroth until today. I sent my daughter over with her car which has Michelin tires purcahsed from this location. They just rotated these tires about a month ago, but the car was virbriating (due to the tires not being balanced) and had a lot of road noise. They treated my wife and daughter terribly, charged them for balancing the tires, which should have been done for free when they rotated them. And then told them that the tires were "six years old". If this is ture they sold me old tires when I thought I was buying new ones, becasue they have only been on the car a few years. And I find it strange that if I needed tires why wasn't that mentioned at the time of rotation a month ago.

reviews.author: Brad C.
reviews.text: I went in for a front end alignment after repairing my truck's front wheel hubs and installing a leveling kit. As a younger looking guy pulled my truck into the alignment bay, he nearly floored the gas pedal and slammed my truck's tires on the lift's safety wheel chocks at the end of the lift. To make matters worse, another employee was directly in front of the truck working at a computer, meaning that the employee driving my truck nearly rammed the vehicle off the lift and into the other mechanic. After this ordeal and a few well-deserved scolds from the mechanic he almost hit, the younger guy had the guts to tell me to "get out of his way" at the bay door. I reluctantly paid and left without any acknowledgement or apology of the multiple mistakes this rookie made.

reviews.author: Melinda Roberts
reviews.text: Service was great.... Took them no more than 15 minutes for them to put a new tire on. Tire was pricey but it was just what they had available in my tire size so not their fault

reviews.author: Ronald Klinger
reviews.text: Delivery of customer friendly service to explain concerned issues. Always working for the customer's best when at times to understand the unexpected expenses.

reviews.author: David Gilchrist
reviews.text: Very good people to do business with. Provided good diagnostics. Also provided a loaner vehicle while my vehicle was being diagnosed.

reviews.author: Gina Dillon
reviews.text: Janie Voght-----Excellent service and explained everything to me. Very nice people and fast service. Wonderful experience

reviews.author: Chuck Oxendine
reviews.text: No longer honoring their punch card that allows you to get a free oil change once you purchase 5. Didn't mention until after the service.

reviews.author: Dannielle Dorbuck
reviews.text: Being the 1st person there at 7:30, I was actually there at 7:00 a.m. and still had to take over an hour to do a simple oil change their responses everything we do takes an hour so don't go here unless you have time

reviews.author: Jessica Camp
reviews.text: Roger is the perfect example of knowledgeable, friendly, customer service. Wish every business had a Roger at their front desk.

reviews.author: Benjamin Jones
reviews.text: Best to come early place gets busy but mechanics are friendly and they work fast getting cars in and out. Would definitely return when i need another tire.

reviews.author: ardmore tv
reviews.text: These guys are the "Real Deal" open on New Yrs. eve. and fixed my girls bent rim put air in the tire and didn't charge me I will buy my next set of tires from here and I live over 30 miles away "Thanks Guys"!..

reviews.author: Karen Bullins
reviews.text: We were on the way to vacation. And had to stop for an emergency. They fixed us up and sent us on our way! Great group of people!

reviews.author: Shannon Randall
reviews.text: Im sorry Roger we wont be doing business with you no more cause you said my work truck needed new wiper blades so i said ok then you said it take a special kind and charged me 75.00 dollars for those real expensive wiper blades and you know it is just a work truck .so sorry we got to part ways

reviews.author: Tracy S. Tuggle
reviews.text: Overcharged for oil change claimed my 6 cylinder needed 7 quarts of oil B***$h** cost me $80.00 was told it would be !45.00 at the beginning. Never Again.

reviews.author: Amy Hand
reviews.text: They help with tour needs and they know their stuff. Roger and joe and the guys will help with all the needs you need. At a reasonable price. Amy

reviews.author: Kurt Whalen
reviews.text: Great service, friendly staff, quick turn around times, and always a loaner available when needed. Thanks Guys!

reviews.author: Nana Murphy
reviews.text: Was a good shop this time except didn't put enough oil n our truck. They came to us n took. Are,of it though.
